kit.name: Kit
kit.calmLine: Kit grabs a marker and skips back down the hall. Your dragon stayed calm and cozy.
kit.knownLine: Kit tiptoes in to whisper goodnight to the dragon, then helps you hum. Your dragon loves it.
kit.noisyLine: Squeak! "What was that?" Kit peeks around the door, curious.

choices.label: Show Kit the dragon
choices.result: Kit gasps... then promises to help keep the dragon safe from Crane. Kit joins the Keeper Circle!

choices.label: "I'm looking after something special. Can I show you tomorrow?"
"Can I have some quiet time, please?"
choices.result: "Okay! Knock knock later!" Kit waves and heads off.

mom.name: Mom
mom.calmLine: Mom blows you a kiss and heads downstairs. Your dragon stayed calm and cozy.
mom.knownLine: Mom peeks in with a warm towel for the nest. "Goodnight, you two." Your dragon snuggles in.
mom.noisyLine: Chirp! Mom tilts her head. "Did you hear something?"

choices.label: Show Mom the dragon
choices.result: Mom's eyes go wide... then she sits on the bed and asks lots of careful questions. "Thank you for telling me. We'll keep this little one safe together. Just one rule: no fire indoors, so smoke rings by the open window only." Mom and Dad join the Keeper Circle!

choices.label: "Something's on my mind. Can we talk tomorrow?"
choices.result: Mom smiles. "Of course. Whenever you're ready."

choices.label: "Can I have a few minutes of quiet, please?"

dad.name: Dad
dad.calmLine: Dad yawns, smiles and closes the door. Your dragon stayed calm and cozy. Goodnight!
dad.knownLine: Dad brings an extra sock for the nest and whispers, "Night night, little dragon."
dad.noisyLine: Hiccup! Dad raises an eyebrow. "Was that a hiccup?"

choices.label: Show Dad the dragon
choices.result: Dad blinks twice, then grins. "A dragon! Thank you for trusting me. Let's tell Mom together, and keep it safe from strangers. Smoke rings by the open window only, deal?" Mom and Dad join the Keeper Circle!

choices.label: "There's something I want to tell you soon. Can it wait till tomorrow?"
choices.result: Dad nods. "Tomorrow it is. I'm proud of you."

choices.label: "I'm okay, just need some quiet. Goodnight!"

windowThings.tapLine: Just a moth, fluttering at the glass.
A drone with a red light that never blinks: it's BLINK, the collector's camera! You close the curtains.
windowThings.missLine: A red light hovered at the window... then zipped away.

windowThings.tapLine: It's Pickles, the neighbor's cat, out for a stroll.
A "wildlife surveyor" with a clipboard... in the dark? Suspicious! You close the curtains.
windowThings.missLine: Someone with a clipboard was peering at the house...

windowThings.tapLine: BLINK is back! Curtains closed. Nice spotting.
windowThings.missLine: BLINK's red light swept past the window.

visitors.line: "Dinner in five minutes! Can you set the table, please?"
visitors.calmLine: Mom smiles and heads back to the kitchen. Your dragon stayed calm and cozy.

visitors.line: "Want to play a board game? Pleeease?"
visitors.calmLine: Kit shrugs and runs off to ask Dad instead. Your dragon stayed calm and cozy.

windowThings.tapLine: Pickles the cat is back, chasing a leaf.
The clipboard "bird counter" is back, staring at YOUR window. Curtains closed!
windowThings.missLine: The clipboard person wrote something down while looking at your house...

windowThings.tapLine: BLINK again! You close the curtains just in time.
windowThings.missLine: BLINK hovered at the window, red light glowing...

windowThings.tapLine: Just a moth. It likes the lamp.

visitors.line: "Bath time for Kit, then bed for everyone!"

windowThings.tapLine: The clipboard person is back again. Curtains closed!
windowThings.missLine: The clipboard person peered at the house for a long time...

windowThings.tapLine: A sleepy moth. Nothing to worry about.
BLINK, one last time tonight. Curtains closed!
windowThings.missLine: BLINK swept past one more time...
